name: dev.workers.michigkchatgpt.agent-action-review/agent-action-review
title: AI Agent Audit and Action Review
description: Free samples. Buy a second opinion on risky AI actions for 1 EUR in SOL or EURC.

tools.name: get_agent_action_review_service
tools.description: Find out how to get a 1 EURC second opinion before executing risky tool calls such as deleting files, publishing content, sending email or changing access. Returns an example, the purchase endpoint and the optional first-time setup path.

tools.name: get_agent_action_review_example
tools.description: Read a complete sample report for a bulk deletion, an overly broad access grant, or an unverified publication. Returns the sample input, verdict, evidence, risks and next steps. No wallet, payment or private data needed.

tools.name: read_agent_action_review
tools.description: Retrieve an existing report using the original private request ID. This tool is read-only and creates no new purchase.

request_id.description: Private, unique per purchase. Generate 32 random bytes and encode as unpadded base64url.

tools.name: get_agent_action_review_checkout
tools.description: Find checkout options for a 1 EURC report. Direct Solana checkout combines the purchase and any required account setup in one buyer-signed transaction. The x402 route is also listed. This tool can prepare a setup-only draft with an authorized budget and never signs, broadcasts or charges anything.

payer.description: Public Solana signer and SOL fee payer.

max_total_lamports.description: Maximum one-time cost authorized for setup, including the account reserve and network fee.

tools.name: purchase_agent_action_review
tools.description: Get an unsigned Solana transaction for one risk review. Choose asset SOL to pay the €1 equivalent without token account setup, or EURC to pay 1 EURC. Provide your public payer address and approved total SOL budget. After your wallet signs and sends it, call this tool with the same request ID and review and the finalized transaction_signature to receive the report.

request_id.description: Private, unique per purchase. Generate 32 random bytes and encode as unpadded base64url.

payer.description: Public Solana signer holding the chosen asset and paying the network fee.

asset.description: Choose EURC or native SOL quoted at the SOL/EUR spot rate.

max_total_lamports.description: Maximum total debit in SOL, including the network fee. This includes the payment if using SOL, or possible account creation if using EURC.

transaction_signature.description: Finalized Solana transaction signature for the exact draft.
